pages.title: Read a wiki in your browser

limitations: Illustrative generation/update requests and commands with example repository paths were not executed as separate workflows.
Integration-test definitions were reviewed, but the integration suite and HTML export were not run for this documentation change.
The guide contains no Mermaid diagrams. The optional checker found no blocks and invoked no renderer; mmdc was unavailable on PATH, so real Mermaid rendering was not verified.
Coverage is limited to end-user generation, settings, audience maintenance, validation/recovery, and local browser reading; implementation extension and model/renderer installation are excluded.

checks: Factual review: audited all five pages against the on-disk generation instructions, validator completion/navigation branches, exporter path/ownership/rendering/search/replacement branches, HTML reader labels and handlers, and relevant integration-test definitions.

Collection structural validation: Test-RepoWiki.ps1 with explicit WikiPath docs/wiki and RepoRoot the local repository; checks registry, general index, and the registered end-users guide separately from factual review.

notes: Checks used local PowerShell 7.6.6. No network requests, package installations, or source-code changes were made.
Two out-of-bounds draft citation endpoints were repaired and the selected-guide check rerun successfully before completion.
The initial working tree was clean. Final git status lists only the nine generated collection files; the source revision remains 867d457d28fa743a55ce4f1a3509d921265a6857.
Structural validation does not establish factual correctness, validate Mermaid syntax, or verify heading fragments. Diagram availability and factual review are recorded separately.
